can you fix the small warning :

epan/dissectors/packet-cigi.c:6829 proto_tree_add_item called for hf_cigi4_terrestrial_surface_conditions_control_condition_id  -  item type is FT_UINT8 but call has len 2
Update also header about supported version ? :)

  • d65a0bce - Adding dissecator version 4 for GICI protocol
[Compare with previous version](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/13554/diffs?diff_id=867421094&start_sha=06c74039c7089dd2f41a3f494bcdeb326b633131)

Apparently this dissector can be set to version 2, 3 or 4.

Please replace your commit message by: "GICI: add dissector for GICI protocol"
there is already 2 and 3 on master branch

Line 4092: Using the `if (tree)` condition possibly creates problems with certain passes through the capture. Better to drop it. 

Line 4248 .. 4334: This enormous if-then-else tree should be replaced with switch-case.

Line 4499 .. 4675: This enormous if-then-else tree should be replaced with switch-case.

Line 9705 .. 9879: This enormous if-then-else tree should be replaced with switch-case.

Line 9896 .. 10012: This enormous if-then-else tree should also be replaced with switch-case.

Same goes for all others that I've missed.

You cannot guarantee that TCP PDU's will always contain a single CIGI PDU. You'll have to use the `tcp_dissect_pdus()` function for this.

I'm not convinced about the strength of the heuristics in the face of other UDP traffic. I'd prefer this to be disabled by default.
